title: Tensor with a flat constructible étale sheaf preserves bounded constructibility
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. On the small étale site use the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_X$ and its module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $L$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] which is flat, meaning that $-\otimes_{\Lambda_X}L$ is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Regard $L$ as $L[0]$ in the unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and let $K\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. For the ordinary étale derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor], there are natural isomorphisms
$$\mathcal H^i(K\otimes^L_\Lambda L[0])\cong\mathcal H^i(K)\otimes_{\Lambda_X}L\qquad(i\in\mathbf Z).$$
These cohomology sheaves are constructible. Consequently $K\otimes^L_\Lambda L[0]\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$, and every cohomological interval $[a,b]$ containing the cohomology of $K$ also contains the cohomology of this tensor product. No finite Tor amplitude is required of $K$.
